mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Corsair Captain: "When this creature enters, create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact
# with "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.") Other Pirates you control get
# +1/+1."
# Enters: the compiler's "When this creature enters" with the compiler's one Treasure TokenSpec
# (M21 Gadrak's verified B2a-gadrak-treasures, FDN Involuntary Employment's), one token.
# Static: M21 Pack Leader's verified "Other Dogs you control get +1/+1." (B4-modify-pt-other-dogs)
# with Pirate. The compiled keywords (the Treasure marker, as on Gadrak) are kept.
treasure = TokenSpec(
    name='Treasure',
    type_line='Artifact',
    types=('Artifact',),
    subtypes=(),
    power=None,
    toughness=None,
    keywords=(Keyword.TREASURE,),
    abilities=(
        ActivatedAbility(
            cost=Cost(
                parts=(
                    CostSacrifice(
                        target=Selector(
                            count=QConst(value=1),
                            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
                            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
                        ),
                    ),
                    CostTap(),
                ),
            ),
            effect=A(Verb.ADD_MANA, {
                'amount': QConst(value=1),
                'color': 'ANY',
                'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
            }),
        ),
    ),
)
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {'count': QConst(value=1), 'tokens': treasure}),
)
lord = StaticAbility(
    effect=A(Verb.MODIFY_PT, {
        'power': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
        'target': Selector(
            count=QUnbounded(),
            mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
            filter=FAnd(
                children=(
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Pirate'),
                    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                    FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
                ),
            ),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
        'toughness': PtDelta(direction=PtDirection.INCREASE, magnitude=QConst(value=1)),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, lord, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, create a Treasure token.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (CREATE_TOKEN one Treasure, the compiler's TokenSpec); keywords[0] the Treasure marker
abilities[1] (StaticAbility: +1/+1 to other Pirate creatures you control)

mapping.notes: The compiler's one Treasure TokenSpec (Gadrak's verified, Involuntary Employment's), one token; the anthem is Pack Leader's verified 'Other Dogs you control get +1/+1.' with Pirate. The compiled Treasure keyword is kept. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/corsair_captain_other_pirates_you_control_and_a_treasure.json, tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/corsair_captain_treasure_pays_for_your_spell.json.

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, create a Treasure token.
clauses.evidence: abilities[0]: ZoneChangeEvent(IS_SOURCE) -> CREATE_TOKEN count 1, the standard Treasure TokenSpec (Artifact, keywords TREASURE, ActivatedAbility cost sacrifice-this + tap, effect ADD_MANA 1 any colour for YOU), the same bytes as the other Treasure makers. Probe [cast] and 'enters during the opponent's turn': ability [0] triggers once, 'you:Treasure moves new -> battlefield' (under your control), one token. The 'keywords +TREASURE' on the creature is the MTGJSON keyword marker the compiler adds (Keyword.TREASURE has no engine behaviour), no mana ability appears on the creature. The Treasure's own ability is not activated in the probe: pack H04_3 pays a spell with it.

abilities[1]: StaticAbility MODIFY_PT +1/+1 over ALL Selector FAnd(CONTROLLER_IS YOU, SUBTYPE_EQ Pirate, Creature, FNot(IS_SOURCE)). Probe [cast]: 'you_pirate: P/T 2/2 -> 3/3' while the Captain itself stays 2/2 ('card on the battlefield: 2/2'); when the Captain dies 'you_pirate: P/T 3/3 -> 2/2'. Opponent's Pirates, other types, control versus ownership and a second Captain are not in the probe: packs H04_1 (only your Pirates), H04_2 (two Captains), H04_5 (control, not ownership), H04_6 (ends when it leaves).
